description: Object /tasks (spec 19.15 Tasks of interface methods, 19.20): the running tasks, their observation by subscription and their cancellation by their owner. The task frames themselves are the transport's task stream (spec 19.15), not signals of this interface.

list.description: The running tasks (started, not ended), in start order.

cancel.description: Cancel a running task. Only its owner may (forbidden otherwise); a task that is not running (ended, unknown) is the refused result, never an error.

started.description: A task started (its start frame follows on the task stream).

ended.description: A task ended (after its done frame).

error.description: The refusal or failure the owner prints as lw: <error>.

TaskInfo.description: A running task: its start meta (spec 19.15) with its id, when it started and its last percent.

kind.description: The operation (build, test, run, clean, reset, ...). Clients show an unknown kind as neutral.

origin.description: The owner's hello.client. Clients show an unknown origin as neutral.

owned.description: The calling connection owns it (it may cancel it).
